prompt: `map_reduce` is called on 7 items with `workers = 3`. It splits the items into chunks of size `ceil(len / workers)`, one scoped thread per chunk. Trace the split.
explain: ceil(7 / 3) is 3, so the chunks hold 3, 3 and 1 items. The partial results are then folded in chunk order, which is why a non-commutative reduce still gives a stable answer.
